# #3063: Patch: an acceptance test holds the pure crates' thread-locals and mutable statics to the list rule 4 allows
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The game's rules code must give the same answer every time for the same game. That is why it may keep only a handful of shared memory slots, each named in the project rules. Nothing checks that list today. Three slots that weren't allowed slipped into the practice AI recently and had to be taken out again by hand. Once this is built, a test fails when a new slot appears and says to update the rules and the list together.

## Why

- CLAUDE.md rule 4 names the only statics the pure crates may hold: the catalog and registry `OnceLock`s, `jackioh-luau`'s VM, and three engine thread-locals (`crates/engine/src/catalog.rs:359` and :388, `crates/engine/src/custom.rs:433`).
- `crates/engine/clippy.toml:4-5` leaves `Cell`, `thread::LocalKey` and the atomics unbanned on purpose. Acceptance V2 (`crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs:4-6`) checks only the dependencies and that the five `clippy.toml` files match.
- Three AI thread-locals got through CI: the Death prices (bac632df40, #2451), then the turn-hook and activation prices. CLAUDE.md was edited to allow them, and e2c26a9ea1 (#2598) removed them two days later.

## Proposal

- A new check in `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` scans `crates/{engine,cards,ai,luau,run}/src`, outside `testkit/` and `#[cfg(test)]` modules.
- It looks for `thread_local!`, `static mut`, and any `static` whose type holds `Cell`, `RefCell`, `UnsafeCell` or an `Atomic*`. It fails on any not on an allow-list of (file, name) pairs that mirrors rule 4.
- The failure message says to change rule 4 and the allow-list in one pull request. The allow-list lives in the test, with a comment pointing at rule 4.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` and its header's list of checks.
- `crates/tools/README.md`, if it lists them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] It passes on today's tree.
- [ ] A scratch-directory test with a `thread_local!` planted in a pure crate's `src` fails with the rule 4 message, as `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_each_covered_directory` does for the helper check.
- [ ] A planted `static X: AtomicU32` fails, and a `static X: OnceLock<…>` passes.
- [ ] It runs in the `tools, wasm` group as the acceptance tests do today.

## Size and risks

Small: about 100 lines in one test file. It reads source text, as the other acceptance scans do, so an unusual way of spelling a declaration could slip through. The testkit's own thread-locals (`seams.rs`, `scenario.rs`, `preview.rs`) must be excluded by path.
